title: FineVAU: A Novel Human-Aligned Benchmark for Fine-Grained Video Anomaly Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the accuracy of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) on normal versus abnormal events within videos, demonstrating that models frequently hallucinate normalcy and conflate abnormal events with normal ones.
Assessing model performance on low-resolution, cluttered CCTV anomaly footage to reveal training biases, as models are typically trained on high-resolution, high-quality, general-purpose videos.
